EchoLingo 0.3.0：可以在应用内直接更新了；下课后的自动标题恢复正常，填写课程背景后，没人说话时不会再冒出背景文字。本版公开发布的是 Mac 版。
EchoLingo 0.3.0 adds in-app updates, fixes automatic session titles, and stops the lecture context from appearing as text while nobody is speaking. This release is for the Mac.

[中文](#中文) · [English](#english)

## 中文

### 更新内容

- **应用内更新**：在 **Settings → General → Updates** 检查更新，一键下载、校验签名、替换并重启。默认在启动时自动检查，有新版时顶部栏会提示，也可以在设置里关闭自动检查。检查更新只访问 GitHub，不上传任何内容；录音、对齐或生成笔记期间不会安装。从下一个版本起可以直接在应用内升级。
- **自动标题恢复正常**：DeepSeek 的新模型（如 `deepseek-flash`）默认先“思考”再回答，把标题请求的回复额度用完后返回空结果，于是下课后不再自动命名，手动生成也提示没有返回标题。现在命名这类短任务会关闭思考，标题为空时会自动重试一次。DeepSeek 的默认模型改为 `deepseek-flash`（旧名 `deepseek-chat` 已被 DeepSeek 停用）。命名失败时，History 里会显示原因。
- **课程背景不再“冒出来”**：填写课程背景后，没人说话时识别区会出现背景文字（例如“机器学习与神经网络”）。现在用其他语言写的背景（例如英文课写的中文背景）只交给翻译参考；本地识别只在检测到有人说话后才使用课程背景，长时间静音后会及时断句。在一段 3.7 分钟、夹有静音和噪声的测试录音上，静音和噪声处不再冒出背景文字：中文背景的误识别从 7 句降到 0 句，英文背景从 8 句降到 2–3 句（剩下的大多出现在模拟的远处嘈杂人声附近）。
- **AI 笔记目录移到右侧**：窗口较宽时，AI 笔记的 Contents 目录显示在笔记右边，不再夹在课程列表和笔记之间。

### 安装

1. 下载下方的 `EchoLingo_0.3.0_aarch64.dmg`，把 EchoLingo 拖进“应用程序”。从 0.2.0 或更早版本升级时直接替换即可，历史记录、设置和已下载的模型都会保留。这是最后一次需要手动安装，之后的版本可以在应用内更新。
2. 本测试版**未经 Apple 公证**，首次打开需要手动放行：
   - macOS 14：在“应用程序”中按住 Control 点按 EchoLingo →“打开”→“打开”。
   - macOS 15 及以上：先双击一次并点“完成”，再到“系统设置 → 隐私与安全性”底部点“仍要打开”。
   - 仍无法打开时，在终端运行 `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/EchoLingo.app`。
   - 替换或更新后，macOS 可能会要求重新授予麦克风和“屏幕与系统录音”权限，并询问是否允许读取已保存的 API Key。
3. 第一次使用时，完成首次设置向导后到 **Settings → Models** 下载本地模型（共约 4.5 GB）。中国大陆网络可以试试 `launchctl setenv HF_ENDPOINT https://hf-mirror.com`，然后 ⌘Q 退出并重新打开应用。

详细用法见 [README](https://github.com/Asphr726/EchoLingo#readme)。

### 系统要求

macOS 14 及以上 · Apple Silicon（M1 或更新）· 建议 16 GB 内存 · 约 6 GB 可用磁盘空间。

### 已知限制

- 未签名、未公证，首次打开需要手动放行（见上）。
- 应用界面目前只有英文。
- 仅支持 Apple Silicon，不支持 Intel Mac。
- 远距离收音效果仍在实测中；教室里的嘈杂人声偶尔仍可能让识别写出课程背景。

## English

### What's new

- **In-app updates**: check for updates in **Settings → General → Updates**, then download, verify the signature, replace the app and restart in one step. EchoLingo checks at launch by default and shows a notice in the top bar when a new version is out; you can turn the automatic check off in Settings. The check only contacts GitHub and uploads nothing, and an update is never installed while you are recording, aligning or writing notes. From the next version on, you can update inside the app.
- **Automatic titles work again**: DeepSeek's new models (such as `deepseek-flash`) think before answering by default, used up the reply budget of the title request and returned nothing, so sessions were no longer named after class and **Generate title** reported that no title came back. Short tasks like naming now turn thinking off, and an empty title is retried once. The DeepSeek default model is now `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek has retired the old name `deepseek-chat`). When naming fails, History shows why.
- **The lecture context no longer shows up as speech**: with a lecture context filled in, the context text (for example "机器学习与神经网络") could appear in the transcript while nobody was speaking. Context written in another language than the lecture (such as Chinese notes for an English lecture) now only guides translation, local recognition uses the context only after it has detected someone speaking, and a long silence now ends the sentence promptly. On a 3.7-minute test recording with inserted silence and noise, the context no longer appears during silence or noise: false lines dropped from 7 to 0 with a Chinese context and from 8 to 2–3 with an English context (most remaining ones came from simulated distant chatter).
- **AI notes contents on the right**: in a wide window the AI notes Contents list now sits to the right of the notes instead of between the session list and the notes.

### Install

1. Download `EchoLingo_0.3.0_aarch64.dmg` below and drag EchoLingo into Applications. When updating from 0.2.0 or earlier, replace the old app; your history, settings and downloaded models are kept. This is the last manual install: later versions can be installed from inside the app.
2. This beta is **not notarized by Apple**, so the first launch needs one manual step:
   - macOS 14: Control-click EchoLingo in Applications → Open → Open.
   - macOS 15 and later: double-click once and choose Done, then click **Open Anyway** at the bottom of System Settings → Privacy & Security.
   - If it still refuses to open, run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/EchoLingo.app` in Terminal.
   - After replacing or updating the app, macOS may ask again for the microphone and Screen & System Audio Recording permissions, and whether EchoLingo may read its saved API keys.
3. On first use, download the local models (about 4.5 GB) in **Settings → Models** after the setup assistant.

See the [README](https://github.com/Asphr726/EchoLingo/blob/main/README.en.md) for the full guide.

### Requirements

macOS 14 or later · Apple Silicon (M1 or newer) · 16 GB of memory recommended · about 6 GB of free disk space.

### Known limitations

- Unsigned and not notarized; see the first-launch steps above.
- The interface is English only for now.
- Apple Silicon only; Intel Macs are not supported.
- Far-field accuracy in real lecture halls is still being tested; chatter in the room can occasionally still make recognition write out the lecture context.
